market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $90 in April?

assessment.reasoning: WTI peaked ~$105+ early April and has consolidated in $95-100 range through the month, currently $96. With supply disruption keeping floor elevated, an intra-month dip below $90 is unlikely given trajectory. Only 2 days left.
